objective.en: Track the heaviest rain cores of the April 2024 severe storms fast enough to warn neighborhoods.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 18% of peak daily GPM IMERG precipitation rate during the 26-28 April 2024 severe storm outbreak (2024-04-26..2024-04-29). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its event total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.7 for this storm setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
